challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge1.de: Your current XP level determines the item you receive.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge2.de: Blocks do not drop any items when broken.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge3.de: Mobs do not drop any items when killed.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge4.de: Chests do not contain any loot.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge5.de: Players do not naturally regenerate health.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge7.de: Allows you to adjust the maximum health of all players.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge9.de: The world border size is determined by your XP level.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge10.d: Receive a random item every 30 seconds.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge11.d: The world generates as a Skyblock.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge12.d: Allows you to limit the number of available inventory slots.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge13.d: Receive a random enchantment every 30 seconds to the item you are holding.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge14.d: Blocks drop random items when broken.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge15.d: Mobs drop random items when killed.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge16.d: Chunks are filled with random blocks.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge17.d: Receive a random item for every 500 blocks walked.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge18.d: Receive a random item for every heart of damage taken.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge19.d: Mining a block applies a random level 1 potion effect (consistent per block/world).
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge20.d: All crafting recipes are randomized and switched.
challengecraft.warning.tainted: Warning: Changing challenges mid-game sets difficulty to 0!
challengecraft.warning.conflict: Warning: Mutually exclusive challenges are active! (e.g. No Drops + Random Drops)
challengecraft.reward.no_xp: No XP earned because challenges were changed in-game.
challengecraft.reward.title: Challenge successfully completed!
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge21.d: No death allowed. If the player dies, the challenge fails and difficulty multiplier is set to 0.
challengecraft.hardcore.failed.desc: Player died in Hardcore Challenge. No XP can be earned from now on.
challengecraft.tainted.failed.desc: No XP can be earned due to mid-game challenge changes.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge22.d: Obtain every survival-obtainable item in a random order to complete the challenge.
challengecraft.all_items_list.title: Items to Collect
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge23.d: Kill every entity which has a spawn egg in a random order to complete the challenge.
challengecraft.all_entities_list.title: Entities to Kill
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge24.d: Allows you to multiply the health of all mobs.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge25.d: Taking damage expands the world border.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge26.d: Complete every Minecraft advancement to complete the challenge.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge27.d: Blocks all armor slots, making it impossible to wear armor.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge28.d: Receive one heart of damage for every block walked.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge29.d: Damage if standing still for 3s or on natural blocks (Grass/Stone). Exclusive to Fire Res perk.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge30.d: Movement speed decreases as your inventory fills. Full inventory grants Slowness VI.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge31.d: Using a tool/weapon has a 5% chance to downgrade its tier (e.g., Iron to Stone).
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge32.d: Multiplayer: All players share a single health pool. Damage to one is damage to all.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge33.d: Mobs spawn with random scales. Small mobs are fast; large mobs have more health/reach.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge34.d: Dropped items float upwards and despawn above world height. Catch them quick!
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge35.d: Multiplies mob spawn rates. Adjust the multiplier with the slider (2x to 10x).
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge36.d: Every 2 minutes, you must answer a trivia question correctly or die.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge37.d: Speeds up the entire game. Adjust the slider from 1x to 10x game speed.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge38.d: Entering a chunk locks the border to that chunk, turns its blocks into one random block type, and spawns a glowing random spawn-egg mob you must defeat to free the border.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge39.d: Prevents players from eating any food, including cake.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge39.b: You cannot eat while No Food is active.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge40.d: Compete in teams to complete a shared 5x5 bingo board. Each goal can only be claimed once. The win target adjusts to the number of teams in the run.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge41.d: Players cannot jump at all while this challenge is active.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge41.b: You cannot jump while No Jumping is active.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge42.d: Every 30 seconds a random mob spawns near each player — including baby zombies, chicken jockeys and armored mobs. Even passive mobs will attack you.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge43.d: Your lowest point is your ceiling: climbing more than a quarter block above it kills you. Portals are safe — everything else only goes down.
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge44.d: Natural blocks drop nothing until unlocked. Mine the block shown on your HUD to unlock its drops permanently and reveal the next one.

challengecraft.dice.no_budget: Out of movement — roll the die!
challengecraft.worldcreate.challenge46.d: Right-click the die to throw it. However many pips land face up is how many blocks you may walk — then you must roll again. Vertical movement is free.

challengecraft.tutorial.tab.body1: This is where you choose your rules — before the world exists.
challengecraft.tutorial.tab.body2: Let's switch three of them on.
challengecraft.tutorial.pick_damage.body: Every time you take damage, you get a random item.
challengecraft.tutorial.pick_walk.title: 2 of 3 — 500 Blocks = Item

challengecraft.tutorial.pick_level.title: 3 of 3 — Level = Item

challengecraft.tutorial.difficulty.body2: It decides the XP you earn for beating the Ender Dragon.

challengecraft.tutorial.helper.body2: Switch it on and watch the rating go DOWN.
